agent.problem: The statement that Job's three friends have been sitting with him is cited to Job 2:11, but that verse describes their coming to him. Their sitting with him is in Job 2:13, so the context reference needs to include that verse.

rule.text: Facts from outside the passage are fine when they help, like who a new person is or who wrote a letter, with their reference.

agent.problem: The joke adds new junk-drawer history: that everyone argued over everything and that nobody ever sold anybody out. Those details are not in Papa Dorin's backstory, and the allowance for invented small moments and habits applies to his bakery.

rule.text: His own world isn't Bible fact. His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them. His jokes can make up small moments and habits around his bakery.
